goal: Act as trial biostatistician for Phase III study DX24-301: audit protocol vs data, find the outlier site and run leave-one-site-out ANCOVA, fit a site-random-effect mixed model with age/sex interactions plus a forest plot, re-estimate the 52-week extension sample size under two scenarios with conditional power, and compare against the UCI Diabetes 130-US Hospitals cohort. Deliver one five-sheet workbook DX24_301_Integrity_Analysis.xlsx.
delivered: output/DX24_301_Integrity_Analysis.xlsx with the five requested sheets (Audit, Site Effects, Subgroup Forest, Sample Size, RWE Comparison). The Subgroup Forest sheet holds an interaction table, four subgroup contrasts and an embedded matplotlib forest-plot PNG (xl/media/image1.png); the RWE sheet reports A1C testing by admission type and metformin/insulin use from the downloaded UCI data.
what_went_wrong: Computations that the rubric checks (LOCF hierarchy, A1C testing rates, medication rates) were right; points were lost on missing explanatory content. The forest plot and subgroup table omit an Overall treatment-effect row (R1); the conditional-power formula used in create_analysis.py line 137 never appears in the workbook, only a verbal definition (R2); the audit flags SD 0.669 vs 1.2 but never says the study was overpowered (R4); and the GLP-1 note says the columns are absent but not that 1999-2008 predates GLP-1 adoption (R3).

failed_items.why: An embedded forest-plot image with a zero reference line does exist (xl/media/image1.png on Subgroup Forest), which the text-only judge could not see, but both the plot and the table show only Age <65, Age >=65, Female, Male and omit the required Overall effect row, so the item fails regardless.

The agent computed CP with an explicit Phi-based formula (create_analysis.py line 137, outside output/) but the Sample Size sheet only states 'P(final z > 1.96 | observed interim z...)'; judge: 'No explicit mathematical conditional-power formula is stated.'

RWE sheet correctly reports metformin 19.6% and insulin 53.4% and says the UCI extract 'contains no GLP-1 medication variables', but never states that the 1999-2008 data predate widespread GLP-1 adoption, which the criterion requires (borderline strict judging).

Audit flags observed pooled SD 0.669% vs assumed 1.2% as 'Yes (lower)' but only says 'both affect power and extension sizing'; it never concludes the original 90%-power design was effectively overpowered.
